new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated multi-timeframe order book liquidity imbalance and zero-spread confirmation prior to trade execution to filter out predatory wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing profit harvest triggers once floating profit hits +$15.00 to guarantee asymmetric $15-$30+ payouts.
